numerology/ank-jyotish/calculation.yaml.algorithm: Reduce birth day for Moolank and the full birth-date digit sum for Bhagyank. For calendar personal year combine birth day/month + target year; add target month for personal month and then calendar day for personal day.

numerology/ank-jyotish/compatibility.yam.node_school_variant: Directed nodal relationships are school-dependent. This matrix adopts editorial affinities for Rahu with Mercury, Venus and Saturn, and Ketu with Jupiter and Mars. Retain the selected table ID with evidence.

numerology/ank-jyotish/compatibility.yam.source: vedic/planets graha.natural_friendships, Brihat Jataka II.16–17, Iyer edition. Nodal edges and same-root affinity are editorial; other Ank schools use different nodal relations.

numerology/kua/profile.yaml.limits: Use only with volunteered calculation input. Li Chun year-boundary profile requires a solar-term instant; keep it distinct from the Gregorian simplification. Outside supported centuries return unknown.
numerology/kua/profile.yaml.method: In the Gregorian-year simplification sum the final two year digits to a single digit. For 1900–1999 subtract from 10 (male convention) or add 5 and reduce (female). For 2000–2099 use 9 or 6 respectively; normalize zero to 9. Replace resulting 5 with 2 or 8 respectively.

numerology/lo-shu/grid.yaml.fill: Count nonzero birth-date digits including duplicates. Keep positions fixed. Missing and repeated cells indicate questions for reflection only.
numerology/lo-shu/grid.yaml.school_variants: Some modern grids insert Moolank and Bhagyank or a consented Kua. Keep those overlays separately labelled; exclude them from the default counts.

numerology/profiles.yaml.date_input: Validated Gregorian local dates; no time-of-day calculation. Target date and selected school are explicit inputs for reproducibility.
numerology/profiles.yaml.name_input: Normalize NFC. Accept ASCII Latin letters, whitespace, hyphens, straight and curly apostrophes and periods. Discard separators only. Spelled-out digits or unsupported characters require a confirmed alphabetic Latin spelling; never drop digits or invent a pronunciation.
numerology/profiles.yaml.projection: Treat number meanings as descriptive. For a scalar outside the documented compound range omit its compound meaning. Keep zero or missing input outside the numbered meaning catalogue.
numerology/profiles.yaml.role: Name-only calculations use the chosen spelling. A birth date is separately needed for date metrics, and maturity needs both.

system_selection.basis: Use the selected market or region setting; language and script do not select a school.

numerology/pythagorean/calculation.yaml.algorithm: At each named reduction stage record the input, then repeatedly sum decimal digits until single-digit or a retained master value. Preserve the raw letter sum separately. Follow the metric IDs below.
numerology/pythagorean/calculation.yaml.convention: Preserve a master input or intermediate digit sum at every component and final reduction, including cycles. Schools can differ on which stages preserve masters.

debt_detection.method: Inspect each compound immediately before its digits are summed. Store stage, reduction index and matched value. Full-digit-sum emits only the final Life Path stage. Omit maturity and calendar cycles.

numerology/pythagorean/calculation.yaml.letter_reference: Cyclic Latin alphabet in nine columns; ordinal A=1 through Z=26 reduced modulo nine.

life_path_methods.components: Reduce month, day and year separately, retaining masters at each reduction; then reduce their sum with the same master stops.
life_path_methods.full-digit-sum: Add all Gregorian birth-date digits before the single reduction chain; retain 11, 22 or 33 whenever reached in that chain.

numerology/pythagorean/calculation.yaml.privacy: Normalize case and remove accepted separators. Reject unsupported characters and empty input. Ask for the intended Latin spelling.

numerology/pythagorean/special-values.ya.trigger: Preserve the intermediate compound and its metric. Use optional reflection without guilt or any claim about past wrongdoing.

rules: Normalize NFC. Preview one Indic script per spelling. Unknown sequences or mixed scripts require an explicit Latin spelling.

Each consonant supplies A unless a vowel sign replaces it or virama removes it. Conjuncts concatenate; permit joiners only immediately after virama. Keep final inherent A; never infer spoken schwa deletion.
Use the listed letter digraphs. Collapse retroflex and dental stops to the same Latin letter; this scoring spelling is intentionally non-reversible. Each Latin character counts separately.
The user confirms the preview or supplies their chosen Latin spelling before scoring. Confirmation takes precedence for pronunciation and family spelling.
